item.title: Creation of a Combined Violin and Box Plot Using R
item.description: Kanaan, Cynthia-Maria et al. -- Keywords: Plots, violin plots, box plots. -- Abstract : The ability to effectively visualize and communicate complex data is crucial, especially when conveying research findings to audiences who may lack specialized training in data interpretation, such as the general public (Grierson et al., 2015; Nordmann et al., 2022).
